Question: a/w mea naam ISTKHAR SAIFI HAIN FROM DELHI mainay pichlay saal apni enggineering complete kari hain per mujay abhi tak koi job nahi mili hain main apnay rozgar ko laker kaafi perassan hoon mujay jalad hi rozgar mil jaay is kay liyay koi wajifa ho tao jarror batay. Answer ID: 11279 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 654/457=H/1430) Recite Surah Alam Nashrah and Surah Quraish thrice after every obligatory salah with durood thrice before and after and pray to Allah. Repeat the same action at night when you go to sleep with wudhu . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
